en.answer: The effect of <<13238>> that Special Summons it from the hand can be activated not only when you Flip Summon a monster, but also when your opponent Flip Summons a monster.
en.question: Can the effect of <<13238>> that Special Summons it from the hand be activated when either player Flip Summons a monster?
